source.name: Explora Journeys press office: Explora Journeys Announces Exclusive Title Partnership With The Swiss SailGP Team
source.quote: Explora Journeys confirmed it has entered into a multi-year major global sports partnership as the Title Partner of the Swiss SailGP Team.
source.note: Announced at Seatrade Cruise Global, Miami; the team races as the Explora Journeys Swiss SailGP Team and the F50 and team apparel were reimagined in the brand's blue.

summary: MSC's cruise brand Explora Journeys took the Swiss title partnership in April 2026; the team now races under its name. The team page's Official Suppliers block (sailgp.com, opened 2026-10-03) lists Oakley, Slam (Official Technical Supplier), POC, Whoop and Velamont, each documented here by an announcement or the team page. The same page's 'Representing Partners' block lists Société Nautique de Genève and Team Tilt — the yacht club and sailing organisation behind the Swiss team, not shirt sponsors — so they are not recorded as sponsors.
